findings.title: Sourcing before compinit runs the completion body
findings.suggested_fix: When sourced before compinit, avoid calling _rg; defer registration until compdef is available or document that compinit must run first.
findings.first_evidence: The FAQ recommends `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` in `.zshrc` (FAQ.md:135). If that line runs before `compinit`, `compdef` is unavailable and line 442 calls `_rg` immediately. `_rg` then uses completion helpers such as `_arguments`, which have not been initialized by compinit.
